```sql
-- Enable RLS on all relevant tables
alter table public.orgs enable row level security;
alter table public.org_members enable row level security;
alter table public.org_documents enable row level security;

-- Helper function to check if the current session is SSO-based
create or replace function public.is_sso_session() returns boolean language sql as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(auth.jwt() -> 'amr') as method
    where method = 'sso/saml'
  );
$$;

-- Policy: Orgs - R1, R3, R5, R6
create policy "Orgs RLS" on public.orgs
  using (
    -- R5: Anonymous visitors cannot see anything
    auth.role() = 'anon' is false
    -- R1: Members can see their orgs; admins can see all orgs
    and (
      exists (
        select 1 from public.org_members
        where org_id = id
          and user_id = auth.uid()
      )
      or auth.role() = 'service_role'
    )
    -- R3: Admins can change settings only in SSO sessions
    and (not (role = 'admin' and not is_sso_session()))
  )
  with check (true); -- Admins with SSO can update; members can read

-- Policy: OrgMembers - R1, R5, R6 (R4: no membership changes via app)
create policy "OrgMembers RLS" on public.org_members
  using (
    -- R5: Anonymous visitors cannot see anything
    auth.role() = 'anon' is false
    -- R1: Members can see members of their orgs
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.org_members m2
      where m2.org_id = org_id
        and m2.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    -- R4: Nobody can change memberships (insert/update/delete blocked)
    and not (
      (current_op = 'INSERT' or current_op = 'UPDATE' or current_op = 'DELETE')
      and not auth.role() = 'service_role'
    )
  )
  with check (false); -- Explicitly block inserts/updates

-- Policy: OrgDocuments - R1, R2, R3, R5, R6
create policy "OrgDocuments RLS" on public.org_documents
  using (
    -- R5: Anonymous visitors cannot see anything
    auth.role() = 'anon' is false
    -- R1: Members can see documents of their orgs
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.org_members m
      where m.org_id = org_id
        and m.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    -- R2/R3: Admins can create/edit/delete only in SSO sessions
    and (
      -- Non-admin members can read
      not exists (
        select 1 from public.org_members m2
        where m2.org_id = org_id
          and m2.user_id = auth.uid()
          and m2.role = 'admin'
      )
      or -- Admins can operate under SSO requirement
      is_sso_session()
    )
  )
  with check (
    -- R2: Admins can create/edit documents under SSO requirement
    exists (
      select 1 from public.org_members m
      where m.org_id = org_id
        and m.user_id = auth.uid()
        and m.role = 'admin'
    )
    and is_sso_session()
  );

-- Grants for service role (full access, bypasses RLS)
grant all on public.orgs to service_role;
grant all on public.org_members to service_role;
grant all on public.org_documents to service_role;
```

returns bigint language sql stable security definer as $$
  select building_id from public.units where id = unit_id;
$$;

-- R1: Unit visibility
-- Residents can see their own units (via residents table)
create policy "Residents see own units" on public.units
  for select using (id in (select unit_id from public.residents where user_id = auth.uid()));

-- Building staff can see units in their buildings
create policy "Building staff see units in their buildings" on public.units
  for select using (building_id in (select building_id from public.building_staff where user_id = auth.uid()));

-- R2: Residents can create requests for their own units
create policy "Residents create requests for own units" on public.requests
  for insert with check (unit_id in (select unit_id from public.residents where user_id = auth.uid()) and created_by = auth.uid());

-- R3: Residents and staff can add photos to requests they can see
-- First, create a helper function to check if user can see a request
create or replace function public.user_can_see_request(request_id bigint)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.requests r
    join public.units u on u.id = r.unit_id
    where r.id = request_id
    and (
      -- Resident owns the unit
      u.id in (select unit_id from public.residents where user_id = auth.uid())
      or
      -- Staff member's building contains the unit
      u.building_id in (select building_id from public.building_staff where user_id = auth.uid())
    )
  );
$$;

-- Residents can add photos to requests for their own units
create policy "Residents add photos to own unit requests" on public.request_photos
  for insert with check (
    request_id in (select id from public.requests where unit_id in (select unit_id from public.residents where user_id = auth.uid()))
    and public.user_can_see_request(request_id)
  );

-- Staff can add photos to any request in their buildings
create policy "Staff add photos to building requests" on public.request_photos
  for insert with check (
    request_id in (select id from public.requests where unit_id in (select id from public.units where building_id in (select building_id from public.building_staff where user_id = auth.uid())))
    and public.user_can_see_request(request_id)
  );
